description: Change the details of one outlet. Takes the outlet id from get_outlets, never a name. Only the fields you pass are changed; the rest are left alone. Renaming is safe and takes effect everywhere, including past orders and reports — they store the outlet id and look the name up. Country cannot be changed here: it belongs to the company. An alias that is already set cannot be changed either and the attempt is refused. Stripe account linking is not editable from here.

alias.description: Only settable while it is still empty

outletId.description: Outlet id from get_outlets — not a name

taxId.description: Business tax number printed on this outlet’s receipts (BN / GST / HST / VAT / EIN)

name: hub_update_outlet
title: Update outlet
